steps.what: Participate in developing study protocols and administration or data collection guidelines

tasks.design: Keep study-specific protocol development with the coordinator and investigators, with working material in {DOCS}. Separately measured document editing can use drafting support, but this participation task has no established clerical share.
tasks.previous_blocker: Administration and collection procedures must fit the study and its subjects.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing collaboration and protocol records support the work; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve practical consequences of a proposed procedure before the study begins.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an operational detail that changes feasibility or participant burden.
tasks.altitude: Development participation and investigator authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: protocol development involves study-specific judgement; document generation capability does not establish a saving for the entire participation task.

assumptions: Boundary is the coordinator's scientific and operational contribution, excluding investigator protocol approval and document editing separately counted under task 15595.

Investigators produce study objectives and draft proposals before discussion; staff produce operational constraints during s1 before the contribution is complete. The coordinator elicits and captures procedures, dependencies, burden and unresolved issues within its full time. No free feasible-procedure flag is assumed.
Missing or conflicting requirements remain in manual discussion. Test native document collaboration before custom tools; none is added.
Incremental upkeep is zero because current development work and tools are unchanged.
unknowns: Protocol complexity and coordinator contribution scope
research_questions: Can any repetitive transcription be measured separately from protocol design participation?

already_counted.description: Operational interpretation, discussion and contribution capture

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0; net=0. Familiar and novel study procedures retain operational design and discussion time; editing is counted separately.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Agree recruitment practices with healthcare professionals

steps.what: Confer with health care professionals to determine appropriate study recruitment practices

tasks.design: Keep discussion of recruitment practice human, using the current study material in {DOCS}. No recruitment outreach, eligibility scoring or automated practice selection is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recruitment feasibility depends on local care pathways and professional judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing professional dialogue remains the relevant method.
tasks.still_hard: Balance appropriate access, participant burden and the study's requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Understand why an apparently productive channel may be inappropriate for a patient group.
tasks.altitude: Consultation duties and study approval authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Care pathway and study population constraints

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selecting recruitment practices with clinicians requires contextual discussion; no distinct clerical baseline is established.

assumptions: Boundary is professional consultation and recommendation, excluding participant outreach, screening and formal recruitment plan approval.

The investigator supplies study requirements before discussion. Health professionals produce pathway constraints and concerns during s1; the coordinator captures and clarifies proposed methods, rationale and unresolved questions within its full time. No structured approved-recruitment-channel flag is assumed.
Test native study document access before custom tools; no new system is proposed.
Incremental upkeep is zero because the existing consultation remains unchanged; professional input is not transferred or increased.
unknowns: Recruitment population and local care pathways
research_questions: Is repetitive evidence retrieval distinct from the professional discussion itself?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0; net=0. Established pathways and difficult recruitment populations both retain professional consultation time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify laboratory findings, subject references and the appropriate communication recipient
Communicate with laboratories or investigators and clarify the findings or required next steps

tasks.design: Keep verification and findings communication with the coordinator using {OTHER} clinical laboratory records and {TELEPHONY}. No model interprets results or chooses a clinical response.
tasks.previous_blocker: Results and recipient responsibilities need verification before discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records and communication equipment support the exchange.
tasks.still_hard: Clarify discrepant findings and ensure the responsible clinician receives the relevant information.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an unresolved or time-sensitive concern and escalate it appropriately.
tasks.altitude: Communication duties and clinical decision rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: communication about laboratory findings includes verification and clarification; no saving is assigned merely because a report is digital.

assumptions: Boundary is coordinator communication, excluding laboratory analysis, clinical interpretation and treatment. {OTHER} means clinical laboratory records system.

The laboratory produces the result report after analysis and before s1. The coordinator verifies report version, subject/sample identity, values, units, source remarks and recipient authority within its full 35%; missing or conflicting facts require manual clarification.
Recipients produce responses during s2 before follow-up is agreed; coordinator capture and clarification remain within its full 65%. No free normal-result or safe-to-disclose flag is assumed.
Test native report access before custom tools; no new configuration is proposed. Incremental upkeep is zero because the existing process remains unchanged.
unknowns: Communication channels and urgent result escalation procedure
research_questions: Is repeated copying a measurable separate activity after verification and clarification?

already_counted.description: Disclosure checks, conversation and follow-up clarification

approvals.approved_version: Exact result report revision, subject/sample reference, recipient, permitted disclosure scope and communicated content checked before each exchange; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+65=100, incremental=0, net=0. Routine findings and discrepant results retain verification and communication time; laboratory runtime is excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain current knowledge of clinical study issues

steps.what: Review scientific literature and participate in continuing education, conferences or seminars

tasks.design: Keep source reading and professional learning with the coordinator, supported by {DOCS} and {LMS}. Summaries may support navigation, but no reduction in learning or conference attendance is claimed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staying current requires understanding methods and applicability rather than receiving a digest.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing publication and education access supports learning.
tasks.still_hard: Judge whether a new finding or practice applies to the current studies.
tasks.human_edge: Connect source evidence to clinical study responsibilities.
tasks.altitude: Learning duties and clinical authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss the relevance of a new study method

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: receiving a summary is not equivalent to maintaining professional understanding; no local discovery-only baseline is established.

assumptions: Boundary is professional learning, excluding separate policy drafting and implementation of changed procedures.

Publishers and educators supply source materials before reading or attendance; the coordinator identifies provenance, relevance and uncertainty within s1. No structured trustworthy-publication flag or preselected complete literature set is assumed; doubtful claims require original-source review.
Test native library and learning-system features before custom tools; no new configuration is proposed.
Incremental upkeep is zero because existing learning and access arrangements are unchanged; no conference or required education time is removed.
unknowns: Actual share spent on discovery versus learning
research_questions: Is repetitive source discovery measurable separately from critical reading and required education?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0; net=0. Familiar updates and unfamiliar clinical methods retain critical learning time; no generic reading compression is counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Study design participation, clinical communication and professional learning remain human work.
reach: Explain operational protocol limits and evidence gaps to scientific management.
role.ambitious_version: A coordinator who can defend the study's operational choices and understand its evidence within existing clinical authority.
